definitions.explanation: Something that stands out from the ordinary; particularly noteworthy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{格別|かくべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦おいしい→おいしい：00740_oishii⟧。
{格別|かくべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧⟦{配慮|はいりょ}→配慮：07700_hairyo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧、⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for your special consideration.

examples.english: It was an exceptionally cold morning.

notes:
{格別|かくべつ} indicates something is notably different from or superior to the ordinary.

Usage patterns:
- {格別|かくべつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + adjective (exceptionally ~)
- {格別|かくべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + noun (special ~)
- [noun]⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{格別|かくべつ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (~ is exceptional)

Common in formal expressions:
- {格別|かくべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧⟦{高配|こうはい}→高配：27410_kouhai⟧ (your special patronage)
- {格別|かくべつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お→お：03097_o⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}て→引き立て：27411_hikitate⟧ (your exceptional support)

- ⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧ (special - more common)
- ⟦{別格|べっかく}→別格：16015_bekkaku⟧ (exceptional, in a class of its own)
